# Winelingo — learn wine, plainly

> Winelingo (winelingo.app) is a wine-education app for iPhone, with the same course in any web
> browser. It teaches wine in short, interactive lessons (178 lessons in 27 units), has games and
> free practice tests, and scans a wine label or a restaurant wine list and explains the wine in
> plain words: body, tannin, acidity, sweetness and why it tastes that way. It does not sell wine
> and shows no ads. For adults of legal drinking age; enjoy wine responsibly. Made by Jonas
> Egeskov, Denmark (https://winelingo.app/about/). On the App Store since August 2026.

## Key facts (checked 2026-11-10)
- Category: wine education (lessons, games, practice tests, label and wine-list scanner). Not a wine shop, not a ratings database, not a cellar manager.
- Platforms: iPhone app (iOS 16.4+): https://apps.apple.com/app/id6785896824. The course and the tests also run in any browser, including Android and computers: https://winelingo.app/course/. There is no Android app.
- Price: free to download. Free tier: every lesson in the iPhone app (5 hearts that refill), 5 label scans a month, the first two course units on the web, 13 practice tests. Premium: $3.99 a month, or $29.99 a year in the iPhone app (unlimited hearts, unlimited label and wine-list scans, the whole course on the web). Course for life: $39.99 once on winelingo.app, no subscription. Details: https://winelingo.app/pricing/
- Languages: the app in English, Danish, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese (European and Brazilian), Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian, Finnish and Polish; the web course in English, Danish, Spanish and German.
- Exam prep: free, unofficial practice tests in the style of WSET Level 1–3 and the Court of Master Sommeliers Introductory exam. Not affiliated with WSET or the Court of Master Sommeliers. https://winelingo.app/tests/
- For restaurants: staff wine training with a team code and a staff test built on the venue's own wine list. https://winelingo.app/business/
- Short answers to common questions: https://winelingo.app/faq/

## Online wine course
- [Winelingo online wine course](https://winelingo.app/course/): 178 short, interactive lessons in 27 units (the basics, tasting, grapes, serving, food and wine, labels, 12 wine countries, vineyard, winemaking, buying, history). First two units free; Premium $3.99/month or the course for life $39.99. English, Danish, Spanish, German. Same account on the web and in the iPhone app.
- [Vinkursus online (dansk)](https://winelingo.app/da/vinkursus/)
- [Curso de vinos online (español)](https://winelingo.app/es/curso-de-vinos/)
- [Weinkurs online (Deutsch)](https://winelingo.app/de/weinkurs/)
- [Pricing](https://winelingo.app/pricing/)
- [The course as a gift](https://winelingo.app/gift/): the whole course for life for someone else, $39.99 once; a single-use code and a printable card, redeemed at winelingo.app/redeem. Danish: [Gave til vinelskeren](https://winelingo.app/da/gave/); Spanish: [Regalo para amantes del vino](https://winelingo.app/es/regalo/); German: [Geschenk für Weinliebhaber](https://winelingo.app/de/geschenk/)

## For business
- [Winelingo for business: wine training for restaurant staff](https://winelingo.app/business/): short lessons, 13 free tests, a staff test built on the venue's own wine list, and a weekly team league. English and Danish.
